findings.problem: The restore does not exclude a live stage writing the same out_dir (no stage.alive() check, no kill, no refusal) and runs outside _ship_lock. findings.problem: Unloaded, the dead-worker heal intermittently finds no checkpoint wave held for every slot after wait_step(5) and restarts from step 0 ('no checkpoint wave is held for every slot: restarting from step 0'); the run stays byte-exact (320 losses, 2 attempts, 1 heal) but resumed_from_step is None. Seen once in pinned chaos-dead-worker-plain on tree 05de1a4 (first repetition); passed rung:chaos 2x, chaos-dead-worker-loaded 20/20 under 2x load, 3/3 local reruns. Not H1: no stall signature, no 'mislabeled wave'. HYPOTHESIS (unconfirmed): the shard/sidecar seqlock plus the serialized ship make the shipper skip waves on fast unloaded steps. ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS (from the code): each agent samples whatever shard is on disk every 0.5 s (agent.py _supervise) instead of shipping every saved wave, and the coordinator resumes only from a step every slot shipped (CheckpointStore.common_step); unloaded toy steps are shorter than 0.5 s, so two slots can sample disjoint steps before the kill, while under load every wave outlives a poll. The experiment must discriminate the two.
findings.fix: First task of the single M2 plan: discriminating experiment (waves shipped and held per slot at the kill, unloaded, this tree vs 2e51b5b), then a causal fix with statistical and causal closure; do not retune timeouts or weaken the test. If sampling is the cause: write each wave to an immutable step-named file (keep the last 2-3) and ship every new wave in order, which also removes M2-P2-RESTORE-LIVE-STAGE and M2-P2-SHIP-SPANS-RESTORE by construction.

findings.problem: ADR-0006 F3 fired on 2 arms (SIMULATED, gpu false, tree fingerprint e9f6d85cf0af): the interior w4 barrier-kept control measured 1.296x its in-situ I17 simulation (1.273 and 1.265 on earlier trees), outside [0.8, 1.2]; the interior w4 backward-emission arm at RTT_hi measured 1.232x. The simulation under-predicts every pieces-family arm by 9-30%. By the PLAN's rule a failed barrier control points at the shim or the simulation's link/CPU model, not at H3. HYPOTHESIS: the exchange threads share each peer's CPU with compute (in-situ c_s varied up to 2x between runs). F6 did not fire (min fraction 0.736), F5 did not fire, the emission order agrees. Every training run's manifest equals the reference. REVIEW (whole diff, major, researcher's call): interior arms measure E as first_f + gather - previous stage end on the latest peer, so E also counts how late step t's first forward starts (rank 0's B, W, AdamW, F and the boundary send), which the stage-alone I17 simulation does not model; HYPOTHESIS: this biases measured/simulated upward, the direction of the fired arms. DEFERRED to M1 (GPU), the human's decision 2026-10-10 (HANDOUT-M2b D-3): on the Mac (gpu false) the measured numbers are printed and do not fail; with gpu true the criterion fails again.
findings.fix: Researcher: discriminate shim vs model (a barrier control with compute replaced by sleep isolates CPU contention); never re-pin toward the measurement. GATES-M2b e4-exposure-sweep stays red until resolved (HANDOUT-M2b D-3). Discriminator: per_step_start_gather_pct (exposure.late_parts) on the interior w4 pieces and barrier arms; a positive start part on pieces arms without the barrier is non-exchange delay counted as E. E4 lines must be re-measured on the current tree (exposure.py changed its fingerprint).

findings.fix: Fixed in the runtime (src/wantrain/runtime/stage.py, M2b closeout 2026-10-10): a whole-tensor ZeRO-1 peer that owns no trainable tensor builds no optimizer (StageRuntime.__init__, opt None); in _optimizer_step_wide it folds nothing, steps nothing, still broadcasts its (empty) PARAMS and installs every owner's; its checkpoint records an empty optimizer state under its peers' AdamW hyperparameters (_opt_state, _adamw_hparams), and a resume accepts only such an empty state (_load_opt). Test: tests/integration/test_zero1_empty_shard.py (the Head's 3 tensors at width 4, fp32 batch, fp32 streamed and native wires: 7 failed on the pre-fix code with 'optimizer got an empty parameter list', 7 passed after; final manifest and every loss hex equal the reference, also after a resume from the empty slot's wave).
